notes.title: Gameplay Improvement Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm very glad to post this improvement update which notably increases the combat speed of the new combat system. 

A few improvements have also been made related to the use of the Xbox gamepad, as well as some minor bug fixes.

A special thanks to Hemmels, who led me to think about tightening the combat phase (without sacrificing the feel of the game). 

Now, let's get ready for 2021! 

Pascal

tags.bug: as well as some minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Combat Phase Update
notes.content:
Hey there everyone,

I’m glad to announce a major update to Westminster Darkly, which greatly improves the game’s overall tactical combat phase. 

What’s new?
-	Improved combat system & unit visualization
-	Updated balancing and uniqueness/utility of combat units
-	Anti-corruption impact potential when an Agent investigates an HQ or Outpost
-	Increased minimal impact when a Militia is rallying at an HQ or Outpost
-	Minor fixes and a few economy-related improvements
-	Gamepad (Xbox-compatible) usability improvements
-	One extra save game slot added
-	Updated Manual 
 
A moment of silence is kindly asked in memory of all the little combat heads that had to be replaced for this major update. ;)

As always, thank you very much for your support!
Pascal

notes.title: Additional Content & Balancing Update
notes.content:
Hey there everyone,
On this 20th day of July 2020, I'm glad to announce another significant update to Westminster Darkly.

What's new:
- The direction & weak point of a unit is now shown as part of the targeting icon
- Integration of local population dots (foreign and domestic) 
- New sounds & voices
- A few more minor balancing adjustments 
- A few more minor bugs have been fixed
- Updated QuickStart Guide

If everything works as planned, Westminster Darkly should be moving out of its early release phase and into its official release phase (v. 1.0) in the next few days. 

As always, thank you very much for your support and I wish you all a splendid week!
Pascal
